name: Repetition-Free Recursive Teaching Dimension of the Repetition-Free Teaching Separation Class
proof: Doliwa--Fan--Simon--Zilles prove that every order-two teaching plan repeats the coordinate set $\{x_1,x_2\}$ for its first two concepts, while an order-three repetition-free plan exists.  Thus $\mathrm{rfRTD}=3$.
